newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia anti-kidnap czar named Cuban ambassador.
newsitem.headline: Colombia anti-kidnap czar named Cuban ambassador.

text.p: Colombia's top anti-kidnap official has stepped down from his post to become ambassador to Cuba, a presidential spokesman said on Thursday.

Alberto Villamizar, whose own wife Maruja Pachon was abducted by the infamous drug lord Pablo Escobar in the late 1980s, has pledged to use his new position as a platform to push for a peace process to end Colombia's three-decade-old internal conflict.

Colombia's leftist rebels have traditionally enjoyed close links with Fidel Castro and the Cuban strongman has frequently been mentioned as a possible intermediary between the government and rebel movements.
Villamizar will replace Antonio Yepes Parra while Ruben Dario Ramirez, who has worked in the government's anti-kidnap department for the last year, will take over Villamizar's job.
